all_findings.description: FIND — `_parse_verdicts` regex `_VERDICT_RE` uses `C\d{4}` which matches exactly 4-digit IDs (C0001–C9999). If the registry exceeds 9999 entries (unlikely for PoC but a latent interface contract violation), IDs like `C10000` won't parse.
